Buyer power is low due to high brand loyalty and ecosystem lock-in. Substitution threat is low-to-moderate, mitigated by the sticky iOS ecosystem, despite the presence of functional alternatives like Android and Windows. Rivalry is intense but Apple competes on differentiation rather than price. Overall, Apple exhibits immense strategic leverage and pricing power.
